name: Google androidtv
description: Controls an Android TV or Google TV: power, volume, keys, and opening apps. It pairs with a code the television shows.
notes: It reaches the television on two ports: one to pair and one to send keys. Both are allowed in advance for the address typed into its settings, so pairing is not interrupted by a question halfway through. To pair: fill in the television's address and its network card address (MAC), press Pair Device, then press Enter Pin with the code the television shows. Fill in the MAC yourself: the module looks it up by running programs on the computer, which a hub does not allow, and it does not save the pairing when that lookup fails. Needs a hub that keeps what a module saves, or it is unpaired by every restart. Proven against a stand-in that speaks a television's pairing and remote messages, not yet a real television.
